title: US stocks today: US stocks end lower as AI slowdown fears hit chipmakers
summary: US stocks ended lower as Nvidia and other chipmakers fell after AI leaders raised safety concerns and called for slower development. Rising Treasury yields, with the 10-year briefly crossing 5%, and higher oil prices added to market pressure ahead of the Federal Reserve meeting, keeping investors cautious.

title: CVC-backed Bamboo Insurance targets $3.24 billion valuation in US IPO
summary: Bamboo Insurance is targeting a valuation of up to $3.24 billion in its US IPO, with selling shareholders seeking to raise as much as $700 million. The residential property insurer plans to offer 35 million shares at $18-$20 apiece and list on the New York Stock Exchange under BMB.

title: China is now ready to address trade concerns with India
summary: China expressed readiness to address India's trade concerns collaboratively.  A recent meeting between ministers discussed bilateral economic and trade ties.  Leaders previously agreed to view each other as partners for development.  China aims to expand mutually beneficial cooperation and address concerns.  This aims to better benefit enterprises and people of both nations.

title: BHEL approves  ₹65 crore further investment in NTPC joint venture NBPPL
summary: BHEL approved a  ₹65 crore investment in its joint venture NBPPL with NTPC Ltd to settle urgent liabilities and maintain operations. The investment aims to be completed in FY2026-27, and no regulatory approvals are needed. BHEL will retain a 50% shareholding in NBPPL.
